PC: Recommend safe sex practices including use of barrier protection
Test for gonorrhea, chlamydia, HIV, syphilis; testing for gonorrhea and chlamydia should be performed at all sites (pharyngeal, genital, anal) of sexual activity
Prevnar 13 (at 65), Pneumovax 23 (at 66), flu vaccine annually, Shingles, Tdap q10 years

Consider DEXA given intermittent hormone use
Fenway Guidelines recommend:
Pre-orchiectomy (on or off hormones), no routine screening
After orchiectomy if >60 years and OFF estrogen therapy for > 5 years
Endocrine society:Consider bone mineral density measurements be obtained if risk factors for osteoporosis exist, specifically in those who stop hormone therapy after gonadectomy.
Consider DRE to evaluate prostate given symptoms (more for risk of prostatitis rather than cancer)
Safe sex practices, including barrier protection
Discuss PrEP (include ongoing need for barrier protection for other STI’s)—if planning to start, check HIV, Hepatitis B, STI’s, BMP

Labs to monitor transition:
Weight, blood pressure
CBC, CMP, lipid, A1c—every 3 months for 1st year; annually after
Prolactin—at baseline and annually
